item.title: Shopify vs. Shopify Plus: When Is the Upgrade Actually Worth It?
item.description:
Shopify and Shopify Plus run on the same core platform, but they are designed for different levels of business complexity.

Shopify Plus offers more customization, advanced B2B capabilities, and additional tools for larger operations. But it also comes with a significantly higher price.

item.title: Cloud-native e-commerce with Laravel: what it takes beyond running on a VM
item.description: Most shops that say they run "in the cloud" are a classic PHP application on a rented virtual machine. That saves buying hardware, but the shop still writes files to its local disk, keeps sessions in memory and needs a bigger machine when traffic grows. If that machine fails, the shop is offline.
